device.description: 16-bit ultra-low-power unbuffered voltage-output DAC with SPI interface, LDAC and bipolar resistors
device.note: dac8830.pdf (SLAS449D) p.1 description, p.4 power supply 2.7-5.5 V and digital inputs, p.5 pin configuration and terminal functions, p.6 Figure 2 timing, p.7 timing characteristics, p.15-16 power-on reset and serial interface

commands.name: Load input register
commands.note: p.16: CS low, SDI latched on SCLK rising MSB first; at CS rising the last 16 bits go to the input register (fewer than 16 bits corrupt the word)

pages: p.1 (reset to zero code), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 (pinouts: SO-14 and QFN-14 same numbering, terminal functions), p.6 (Figure 2: LDAC low updates the DAC latch), p.7 (timing), p.16 (power-on reset, serial interface); dac8830-ep.pdf (DAC8831MCDEP)
notModeled: analog: unbuffered voltage output, Kelvin reference inputs, bipolar scaling resistors (RFB, INV)
a frame of fewer than 16 bits corrupts the word (bits remain from the previous word); the model ignores frames shorter than 16 bits
the serial shift register is undefined at power-up
variants: dac8830.pdf covers the DAC8830 (SO-8, no LDAC) and DAC8831; DAC8831MCDEP (dac8830-ep.pdf, -55 to 125 C) has the same pinout and interface; DAC8832 (dac8832.pdf) is the mid-scale-reset QFN version
